# Antariksh Academy

> Antariksh Academy is a premier higher secondary science coaching and competitive entrance preparatory institute located in Bijipur, Brahmapur (Berhampur), Odisha. Established in 2017, the academy provides rigorous dual-track academic coaching integrating Class 11 and Class 12 (+2 Science CHSE Odisha Council Board) with national competitive examinations including JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET-UG Medical, and OUAT & ICAR entrance assessments. Antariksh Academy operates with a strict 30-student batch capacity limit, daily 1-on-1 faculty doubt clearing desks, and structured weekly subjective and OMR diagnostic testing.

## Overview & Institutional Philosophy
Antariksh Academy operates on the principle that council board excellence and competitive entrance success reinforce one another when taught systematically rather than as competing tracks. Classroom lectures derive foundational concepts step-by-step for subjective board examinations before introducing objective shortcuts, high-yield numerical problem-solving, and negative-marking management for national entrance tests.

- [Antariksh Academy Home](https://antarikshacademy.vercel.app/): Official web portal with institutional highlights, admissions status, course roadmaps, and online consultation scheduling.
- [About Us & Pedagogical Model](https://antarikshacademy.vercel.app/about): Founding history since 2017, leadership mission, synchronized dual-track syllabus architecture, and the capped 30-student batch policy.

## Academic Programs & Curriculum
All courses feature synchronized dual-track teaching, comprehensive printed study materials, Daily Practice Problem (DPP) sheets, and weekly proctored examinations.

- [Course Offerings & Entrance Wings](https://antarikshacademy.vercel.app/courses): Complete curriculum specifications for:
  - Integrated +2 Science (CHSE Odisha) + JEE (Main & Advanced)
  - Integrated +2 Science (CHSE Odisha) + NEET-UG Medical
  - +2 Science Pure Council Board Foundation (Class 11 & Class 12)
  - OUAT & ICAR Specialized Agricultural Entrance Batch
  - Repeater & Dropper Fast-Track Intensive Programs
- [Class & Batch Timetable](https://antarikshacademy.vercel.app/timetable): Morning and evening batch schedules designed to prevent student fatigue and ensure zero overlap with college hours.

## Faculty Mentorship & Academic Leadership
Teaching at Antariksh Academy is led by full-time senior subject mentors with over a decade of specialized coaching experience across physics, chemistry, mathematics, and biology.

- [Faculty & Mentors Directory](https://antarikshacademy.vercel.app/faculty): Senior educators profile, subject specializations, and daily 1-on-1 evening doubt resolution desks.

## Academic Track Record & Benchmarks
The academy maintains an unbroken 100% first-division pass record in CHSE Odisha Council examinations alongside consistent admissions to National Institutes of Technology (NITs), Indian Institutes of Information Technology (IIITs), premier Government Medical Colleges (MKCG, SCB, VIMSAR), and OUAT Bhubaneswar.

- [10-Year Hall of Fame & Track Record](https://antarikshacademy.vercel.app/results): Verified academic achievements, departmental benchmarks, and historical performance from 2017 to 2026.
